objective: Build the first bounded GM/owner-facing application slice for discovering, inspecting, reviewing and drafting against CCTI candidate content while preserving noncanonical and runtime boundaries.
construction_summary: GM/owner-only Content Lab is routed through the existing Internal Alpha GM entry and existing game-master authorization path; Player accounts are denied before candidate content is rendered
public entity-catalog candidate projection contract carries explicit canonicalEnabled=false and runtimeAssetMutationAllowed=false capabilities
stable governed subject identity remains separate from optional current Definition identity so legacy/reference-only records are not invented into Definitions
candidate discovery supports text, domain and review-state filtering; large projections render a bounded 100-card result window
inspection exposes candidate facets, dispositions, source evidence and review reasons while preserving Definition/Platform Model versus A8 Asset Instance boundaries
review notes and ready-for-owner-review marks remain browser memory only and may be exported only as a noncanonical local JSON review packet requesting no canonical, relationship or runtime mutation
governed private projection JSON may be loaded from the local device with no upload or persistence path

private projection builder consumes governed private shared-context, Platform cross-facet, relationship-candidate and withheld-signal ledgers without modifying inputs or committing the private 11,017-row candidate corpus
shared controls and the DT-008 changed-line ratchet are enforced in the dedicated validation lane
